sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **European Green Deal (EGD)**: The roadmap for making the EU's economy sustainable by turning climate and environmental challenges into opportunities. 
• **European Climate Law**: Legally binds the EU to reach climate neutrality by 2050 and reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to 1990 levels. 
• **Fit for 55 Package**: A set of proposals to revise and update EU legislation to ensure that EU policies are in line with the climate goals agreed upon in the European Climate Law. 
• **Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)**: A climate measure that puts a fair price on the carbon emitted during the production of carbon-intensive goods that are entering the EU.

items.definition: Prevents 'carbon leakage' by ensuring imported goods face carbon costs equivalent to domestic EU production; critical for India's steel/aluminum exports.
Financial support tool to ensure the transition to a climate-neutral economy happens in a fair way, leaving no one behind, especially in coal-dependent regions.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **EU Taxonomy**: A classification system defining 'environmentally sustainable' economic activities to guide green investments. 
• **Farm to Fork Strategy**: Aims to make food systems fair, healthy, and environmentally friendly.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: High energy costs, industrial competitiveness, and geopolitical dependence on critical raw materials. 
• **Solutions**: Scaling up renewable energy, hydrogen economy, and strategic autonomy in supply chains.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'C-F-E-T' (Climate, Fit, Economy, Taxonomy). 
• **Decoded Meaning**: C (Climate Law), F (Fit for 55), E (ETS/Energy), T (Taxonomy/Transition).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'EU ETS' with 'Carbon Tax'. ETS is a market-based cap-and-trade system, whereas a Carbon Tax is a fixed price per unit of emission.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Green Protectionism' when discussing CBAM in the context of India-EU trade relations.

keyTakeaways: The EU Green Deal is the world's most comprehensive legislative climate framework.
CBAM is a potential non-tariff barrier that India must navigate through green technology adoption.
The EU Taxonomy is the gold standard for defining 'Green Finance' globally.
